XCRI.name: Combined References
XCRI.note: The cell's combined references: how many meshes it combines and how many references it holds, then the meshes and the references. [documented: xEdit wbDefinitionsFO4.pas (Mozilla Public License 1.1), wbStruct(XCRI, 'Combined References', [...]). measured: all 4,600 XCRI subrecords in Fallout4.esm are eight bytes plus four for each mesh and four for each reference, so a reference is the form ID alone and the combined mesh xEdit shows beside it is worked out from it rather than stored.]

struct.name: Meshes Count
struct.note: How many meshes the cell combines.

struct.name: References Count
struct.note: How many references the cell holds.

struct.name: References
struct.note: The references. Each is the form ID of the reference alone.
